summary: Resolute Holdings Management filed an 8-K reporting third-quarter 2026 results and disclosing that its board authorized an increase of its share repurchase program to $100.0 million, with no expiration date. Repurchases may occur via open market, privately negotiated transactions, tender offers, or other methods at management's discretion, sized by market conditions, liquidity and alternatives. No price, share count or premium is stated; the program is non-binding and may be modified, suspended or discontinued anytime. Watch execution pace, buyback-driven EPS accretion and any signal of undervaluation.
